```json
{
  "tests": [
    {
      "name": "Happy path with prefix and message",
      "given": "w=buf, prefix=\"ERROR: \", message=\"something went wrong\"",
      "expect": "ERROR: something went wrong\n",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Empty prefix and message",
      "given": "w=buf, prefix=\"\", message=\"\"",
      "expect": "\n",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Only prefix provided",
      "given": "w=buf, prefix=\"FAIL: \", message=\"\"",
      "expect": "FAIL: \n",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "input:prefix"
    },
    {
      "name": "Only message provided",
      "given": "w=buf, prefix=\"\", message=\"error\"",
      "expect": "error\n",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "input:message"
    },
    {
      "name": "Writer returns error",
      "given": "w=errWriter, prefix=\"P: \", message=\"M\"",
      "expect": "error",
      "polarity": "negative",
      "covers": "boundary"
    }
  ]
}
```

```go
package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"testing"
)

type printErrorErrWriter struct {
	err error
}

func (e *printErrorErrWriter) Write(p []byte) (n int, err error) {
	return 0, e.err
}

func TestPrintError(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		w         io.Writer
		prefix    string
		message   string
		want      string
		wantErr   bool
		isErrBuf  bool
		errWriter *printErrorErrWriter
	}{
		{
			name:    "Happy path with prefix and message",
			w:       new(bytes.Buffer),
			prefix:  "ERROR: ",
			message: "something went wrong",
			want:    "ERROR: something went wrong\n",
		},
		{
			name:    "Empty prefix and message",
			w:       new(bytes.Buffer),
			prefix:  "",
			message: "",
			want:    "\n",
		},
		{
			name:    "Only prefix provided",
			w:       new(bytes.Buffer),
			prefix:  "FAIL: ",
			message: "",
			want:    "FAIL: \n",
		},
		{
			name:    "Only message provided",
			w:       new(bytes.Buffer),
			prefix:  "",
			message: "error",
			want:    "error\n",
		},
		{
			name:        "Writer returns error",
			errWriter:   &printErrorErrWriter{err: errors.New("write failed")},
			prefix:      "P: ",
			message:     "M",
			wantErr:     true,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var w io.Writer
			if tt.errWriter != nil {
				w = tt.errWriter
			} else {
				w = tt.w
			}

			// We cannot check the return value because the signature returns void.
			// However, the contract implies side effects. 
			// Since we cannot change the signature to return error, 
			// we test the side effect via the buffer or the fact that it doesn't panic.
			// For the error case, we'll just ensure it handles the error gracefully (no panic).
			
			defer func() {
				if r := recover(); r != nil {
					t.Errorf("printError panicked: %v", r)
				}
			}()

			printError(w, tt.prefix, tt.message)

			if tt.wantErr {
				return
			}

			buf := tt.w.(*bytes.Buffer)
			if buf.String() != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("printError() got = %q, want %q", buf.String(), tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
```
